title: Kansas couple sought $550,000 over wedding venue sprinkler rules; appeals court revives one claim
summary_full: A Kansas couple who planned to build a wedding venue sought more than $550,000 in damages after a two-year construction delay and changes to local building rules led to a dispute over sprinkler requirements. The Kansas Court of Appeals has now revived their equal protection claim against Leavenworth County while upholding the dismissal of their other claims.
